list: The official 55 trophies as published on PlayStation Network, mirrored by Exophase and PSNProfiles, checked 18 November 2026: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned.
note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list. Guides are written for this page, in our own words, from the cited sources. Source keys resolve in app/data/sources.json.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the last trophy you earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done. There is no shortcut and nothing online or DLC-gated about it — single-player only. Work through the roadmap in order; A Long Road, the gold for 100% completion, is usually the final piece.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1 — just play the opening mission through to its end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Finishing Chapter 1 earns it; PowerPyx notes it pops once you complete the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, which closes out Chapter 1. Keep playing the story.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Complete Chapter 2; PowerPyx notes it pops after the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Complete Chapter 3; PowerPyx notes it pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. Complete Chapter 4; PowerPyx notes it pops after the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed, and one of only two golds. Complete the final mission of the story — PowerPyx lists the last mission as Starting From Zero in Chapter 4 — and the gold pops when the story ends.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run — finish that mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist — finish that mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play — finish that mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners — finish that mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown — finish that mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: A story trophy that cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory — finish that mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and usually the last one before the platinum. The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts. PowerPyx stresses the requirements are lenient — closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, collectibles are only partly required (scan any 200 of 277 vehicles, study any 100 of 255 animals), and you need any 70 of the 80 challenges. The only tasks that need everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing toward 100% is missable, and everything can be done in free-roam after the story. Do optional missions as they appear — you need any 100 of them — and scan vehicles and study animals from the start.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps. You can mix the categories, and PowerPyx calls Under the Bridges the quickest to clear. Track progress in Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where every stunt keeps its own name and marker. Note that the 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check Progress > Activities to see which types you have done; the map's Activities filter (the blue dumbbell icon) marks most of them. You will try one of each naturally while chasing the other trophies, so do not grind this one early.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. PowerPyx maps all 12 locations and all 42 gold medals. The gold medals are not too hard, and the ranges also feed the 100% checklist, which needs all of them done.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations — 42 drone races in total, per PowerPyx. You need one win per location, not all 42 races. PowerPyx lists all 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations (PowerPyx maps them all), so pick the 20 shortest and easiest — each race only counts once, so work through the list rather than repeating one you like.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in the challenge he sets.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. There are 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. Finishing all the levels of any one game once is enough — you do not need to beat every challenge in it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia: she gets a call from Andy, then a text with her address in Belville. Five quests lead to the trophy — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of them are still available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1; after the mission Island Dreams he calls and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find the chests on the ocean floor with the metal detector and bring them back to him. Kenton goes quiet during parts of the story but comes back in Chapters 2-3, so nothing here is missable. Track progress under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests lead to the trophy — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All of them are still available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count — PowerPyx warns that Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. Strands confirmed to count are Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries), with more still being found. All of them remain available after the story in free-roam, and the trophy tracker in the game's trophy list shows how many you have done.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's Wish List questline is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is on the list, then drive it back — delivering in good condition pays more. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. It can all be done after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's questline is marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty and is Jason-only. Go to the Synthetic Labs (purple markers, quest Take Out Kitty Litter) and destroy them; after enough labs are gone, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, and shutting the labs down earns the trophy. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Potentially missable: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation can only be done during Chapter 1, and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. You can meditate with both Jason and Lucia at each spot, which counts as +2 at the same location; track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. POTENTIALLY MISSABLE: the first meditation, on the balcony at Jason's house, can only be done during Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks out to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether this one is actually required (it is not marked as a meditation spot), but do it anyway — there is no mission replay. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break; playing as Jason you get a text marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County (Lucia cannot receive it). Bret gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 and marks hunting spots with purple icons — hunt the animals he requests and bring them back to him as Jason. Track the 15 Target Decks under Map > Activities; all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this comes naturally along the way. PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed exactly which animal pops the trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 card sets in total, and PowerPyx maps all 18 — you only need any 3 complete sets, so pick the sets whose cards you keep finding and finish those first.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Hold Up and then R1 to scan scannable objects in the world — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher tags, per PowerPyx. There are more than 100 in total, so any 100 count; scan whatever you pass and this finishes on its own.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges and you need any 50 — 70 for the 100% checklist — so skip the hardest 10. Track them under Progress > Challenges. Most complete naturally while working on other trophies; save this for late in the run, then pick the easiest and quickest ones you have left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Available from Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can free-roam as Jason and Lucia together — call your partner with Right + Triangle. Build 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone: a fast sports motorcycle helps, and PowerPyx recommends driving through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… and while robbing bank vaults for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, call your partner (Right + Triangle) and hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) while staying wanted the whole time — keep the flashing wanted level, not the red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix or Adrenaline). The unlock is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop; if it does not pop, hit a 4th. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, unlocked after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — loot a couple of items in each and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app from your phone (hold Up) and scan vehicles with R1 — stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. You only need to scan them, not drive them; the game has 557 vehicles at launch. Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. You need 200 scanned for the 100% checklist, so this pops on the way there.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: it slows time and highlights weak spots, draining the purple focus bar. Buff focus first (food, drinks, washing up at home, Adrenaline to extend it), wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto weapon like the Duke 556. Line up 5 enemies at a gang operation and drop them without missing a shot. PowerPyx notes it does not work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — by Focus level 4 this gets much easier, and it may pop naturally.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal — one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not the planes parked out on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, go upstairs into the cockpit, reverse the plane to the strip and take off. Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport before it pops.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. Tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate — or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance — climb into a Rhino and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (do not kick the door — that trips the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, and loot the safe. PowerPyx recommends Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and rob it — bring your partner along to carry a second bag of cash. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip (after his Payday Loans quests) to mark security vans with a purple icon. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to lose the heat. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and all 8 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. This pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — robbing the bank vault there counts as robbing an armored truck. To get it earlier: spot an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray). All 8 large bank jobs are needed for the 100% checklist anyway, so this comes free with Maximum Withdrawal.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until none is left. A plane is available from early in Chapter 1, so you can start unfogging long before the story ends.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal operations; you need just 1 operation per gang for this trophy, but all 39 for the 100% checklist. Operations are marked by yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically by story progress. Track per-gang counts under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED as of 19 November 2026. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown — no guide has confirmed how it pops. The description points to a quiet moment with a cocktail overlooking Ocean Beach, but until a guide verifies the exact spot and trigger, treat any specific method you read online as unconfirmed. This page will be updated when a source confirms it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only steal it after getting the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. The pop is slightly delayed — keep driving away from the showroom. Only this blue Banshee counts, not any other car; it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. During the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling — Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation — steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which you blow open with sticky bombs (buy them at an Ammu-Nation first). The trophy pops after you escape the police. You do not need all 3 in one visit: the robbery icon respawns after a while, so you can come back for whatever is left.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Available from Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between characters. Work out at a fitness club — buy a membership, and filter clubs on Map > Activities — and always bring your partner along (Right + Triangle): while one character trains, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (the heart icon). You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — the trophy list shows your count out of 500. Turn on criminal profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) so a small demon-face icon appears whenever an action counts. The profile runs Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing), Psycho (mass killing) and Irredeemable — a permanent status from excessive violence, best avoided, since cops get far more aggressive. It accrues passively through robberies and fights; if it is your last trophy, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED as of 19 November 2026. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown — believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, but no guide has verified the exact trigger. Treat any specific method you read online as unconfirmed until a source verifies it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED as of 19 November 2026. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown — believed to be tied to a UFO questline, but no guide has verified the exact trigger. Treat any specific method you read online as unconfirmed until a source verifies it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED as of 19 November 2026. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown — believed to involve knocking enemies over while driving a motorcycle (a melee drive-by), but no guide has verified the exact trigger. Treat any specific method you read online as unconfirmed until a source verifies it.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative, not in one trip. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery (unlocked after Chapter 4's That's Where The Money Is…), so this comes naturally with the robbery trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest — they are the most expensive things in the game. The total counts across every shop type: 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores (shop counts per PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 purchasable garages (plus 4 story-related ones that do not count), costing $160,000 in total. They go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4, are the fastest way to fund them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). You need enough garage space first — each garage adds parking spots — so buy the garages for Little Boxes, then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
